entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to start a return for an order I placed a couple of months back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Trail Helmet in Slate Gray. I see it was delivered about 77 days ago. Can you tell me what the issue is with the helmet?
There's no issue with it, per se. The box is still unopened. The color just wasn't what I was expecting once I saw it in person, and I've just been busy and haven't had a chance to call.

I understand. Let me just confirm our policy here... Yes, it looks like standard items like this helmet have a 90-day return window. Since you're at day 77, you're well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and email you a pre-paid return label right now.

That's great, thank you. I do have one other question. I'm a VIP member and I'm going to be ordering another helmet right away. Since I have to go through the trouble of sending this one back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order?

That's a reasonable request. Let me check your account. Yes, I see you're one of our top customers. We definitely want to make sure you get the right gear, especially for something as important as safety. I can absolutely add a 15% off coupon to your account for your next purchase. Would that work?
A 15% discount would be perfect. Thank you so much for your help, Diana.

You are very welcome. I've just processed the return label and applied the discount to your account. You should receive two separate emails shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've made this very easy. Have a great day.
You too. Thank you for being a VeloFit customer.
